purpose: Create a deterministic multi-file text project, retain it as a grounded draft when checks expose gaps, or require complete deterministic validation when explicitly requested.

properties.path: target project directory, absolute or relative to the machine root
properties.files: object mapping project-relative file paths to exact UTF-8 text
properties.publish_mode: grounded-draft by default; validated when failed checks must block publication

output_contract.validation: deterministic pre-publish and post-publish grounding with exact requested-text integrity; ordinary creation retains visible gaps unless validated mode is explicitly selected

relationships: creates project bodies outside the protected machine body
retains imperfect ordinary creations with observed validation gaps instead of erasing them
pairs with AXM-CAP-VERIFY-PROJECT for independent post-create verification

anatomy_refs.basis: This live capability creates and publishes a bounded multi-file project assembly with explicit input/output, exact-content integrity, deterministic grounding, and caller-selected strict validation.

limitations: current milestone writes text files only
grounded-draft retains failed validation checks as visible gaps; it does not claim those checks passed
JSON validation proves parseability, not schema or semantic correctness
static-web validation checks local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript module references but not complete language validity or browser behavior
project validation rejects symlinks rather than reading through them into a different filesystem body
generated code is validated but not executed
visual and interactive behavior still requires an authorized browser/host test
